decisions.reason: After four years of public commitment, several models, and centrality to underground mining, escalation of commitment makes withdrawal very unlikely.
As a construction-site product central to the firm's announced direction and already publicly listed, the firm persists despite limited market evidence.
Although the furniture lift is less central, the firm has invested in a multi-model line and publicly presented it, so escalation of commitment favors continuation.
The building material lift is close to the firm's core lifting and construction tasks and has received dedicated public pages, making management reluctant to drop it after three years.
This single-model truck-mounted lift is more peripheral and involves less sunk investment, but its public presentation and three years on the market still tilt toward keeping it.
